Olam[2] is a dead[3] aasimar[4] Harper whose corpse is in the House of Healing Morgue. He attempted to lift the Shadow Curse more than a hundred years before the events of Act Two, until he eventually succumbed to the darkness.
“
'All beings should walk free of fear', I was taught. Oh, if only were I granted such a fine fate.
„
— Olam, in his journal.

History

Siege of Reithwin

When  Ketheric Thorm amassed an army of  Dark Justiciars to plunge the world into shadow at the behest of  Shar, Olam was part of the combined forces of Harpers and druids from the Emerald Grove intent on stopping him. Their crusade suffered setbacks and defeats at first, but the combined might of the Harpers and druids, along with the involvement of  Yurgir and his merregons, eventually whittled down and destroyed the entire Dark Justiciar army. Ketheric Thorm was then finally killed in battle and sealed in Reithwin's Grand Mausoleum by the Harpers - but not before he uttered his final curse.

The Harpers and druids were scattered when Ketheric's final words brought the Shadow Curse upon the surrounding lands, afflicting any survivors from the battle and all the town's remaining inhabitants.

Shadow Curse

Over the period of a few short days, the now-Shadow-Cursed Lands fell into darkness, causing harm to any who remained or ventured in it, and transforming into undead any who remained too long.

Olam survived the first few days, protected by his armour, while his fellow Harpers fell to the curse and rose as Shadows. He hid and set up traps, with the company of his familiar, Corvin.

On the fifth day, Olam set out searching for artefacts or scrolls in hopes of finding ways to ward off the Shadow Curse, as well as any other survivors. For the next weeks, his searching lead him to books, scrolls, and artefacts, but none of them useful in protecting against the curse. Olam mentioned hearing sounds from the House of Healing, but did not enter as the source of those were  Shadow-Cursed Undead. Instead, he took comfort in his familiar Corvin's presence, and attempted to remove the Shadow Curse through spellcraft.[5] Though his research was inconclusive - his efforts instead culminated in his turning his gear into living armour.[6]

Eventually, on his third tenday in the Shadow Curse, Olam made his way into the House of Healing Morgue where he continued his research. During his last hours, he summoned his familiar Corvin for comfort and affection, despite the Shadow Curse tormenting the two of them. Olam soon succumbed to the Shadow Curse, leaving behind his  journal and  Research Notes (House of Healing) and  Shadow-Animated armour behind.[7]
